title: idc-radiomics: Zero-setup access to TotalSegmentator anatomy and radiomics features for NCI Imaging Data Commons CT scans
description: Python library for querying TotalSegmentator anatomy segmentations and 28 per-structure radiomics features for 125k+ NLST CT scans from the NCI Imaging Data Commons, without BigQuery or a Google Cloud account. Streams the public CloudSegmentatorResults parquet via DuckDB httpfs.
